about: Need labels of the two fresh form runs only. The skill labels of each item are those of tests/fixtures/gate-a/labels.json, unchanged; score-hits.ts gets both through the jq command of the README section "Scores and fresh sets". The run field names the form: fresh1 is forms/fresh-1/, fresh2 is forms/fresh-2/.
rules: Each free-text need of fresh-1 and fresh-2 lists every skill that serves it, library or pool, or none, with the rules and needs_rules of tests/fixtures/gate-a/labels.json.

A fresh need that asks for the same work as a need of the same item in labels.json gets the same skills, so that the fresh runs are scored by the standard of the first runs; follows quotes that need. When the fresh need also names a technology that the old need does not, the library skill of that technology is added, with the reason (only rex-gap-ts, for TypeScript).
A need with no such twin is labelled from the headers at 54d74f2 by the same rules; follows says new and gives the reason.

A pool skill is named only by one of the four folder names that labels.json names (sqlite, claude-code, mcp-server-builder, tdd), and only when it is the very technology that the need names. The judge did not list or read the pool: only the runner scripts and rex skills search reach it. So a need that names another technology names no pool skill.
rex-code-essentials is not labelled on a need: it is the output of 0h0d1109wo-T1, and on the other items it is a skill label of labels.json.
